content: Cost-conscious AI options for meeting-summary/task-extraction in 2026: Gemini 2.5 Flash (~$0.30/$2.50 per 1M in/out) or Gemini Flash-Lite (~$0.075/$0.30) are cheapest capable options with a generous free tier via Google AI Studio API key; GPT-4o mini / GPT-5.x mini (~$0.15-0.40/$0.60-1.60) and Claude Haiku 4.5 (~$1/$5) are pricier alternatives. For structured task extraction (title/owner/deadline), OpenAI Structured Outputs (strict JSON schema, zero invalid outputs) is the most reliable; Gemini enforces schema only via function calling / response_schema, not a bare JSON mode.
